items.name: Crowbar
items.effect: Hits a door or wall automatically for 2D6 and never breaks.
items.description: A heavy metal bar with a curved end, used for prying open doors or crates.

items.name: Hammer
items.effect: Hits a door or wall automatically for 2D4 and never breaks.
items.description: A heavy metal hammer, used for driving nails or breaking things.

items.name: Needle & Thread
items.effect: Repairs clothing on a CRAFTING roll.
items.description: A small needle and a spool of thread, used for sewing or mending clothes.

items.name: Pickaxe
items.effect: Hits a door or wall automatically for 2D8 and never breaks.
items.description: A heavy metal pickaxe, used for breaking rocks or digging.

items.name: Saw
items.effect: Gets through wood or metal in a stretch.
items.description: A sharp saw, used for cutting wood or other materials.

items.name: Shovel
items.description: A heavy shovel, used for digging or moving dirt.

items.name: Sledgehammer
items.effect: Hits a door or wall automatically for 2D10 and never breaks.
items.description: A heavy sledgehammer, used for breaking down walls or doors.

items.name: Blacksmithing Tools
items.description: A set of tools used for blacksmithing, including a hammer, tongs, and anvil.

items.name: Carpentry Tools
items.description: A set of tools used for carpentry, including saws, hammers, and chisels.

items.name: Tanning Tools
items.description: A set of tools used for tanning hides, including knives and scrapers.
